author: notCVE
text: CISA KEV added CVE-2026-46300 (2026-10-28): Linux Kernel missing initialization of a variable, actively exploited. CVSS 7.8, EPSS 10.2%, 30 public exploits.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-46300 HIGH actively exploited per CISA KEV, Linux Kernel. CVSS 7.8 EPSS 10%.

author: jorgeliauw
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) is now actively exploited in the wild & added to CISA KEV. Real attack traffic targeting Node.js 24.22.0 on x86-64. Full RCE works on stock binaries with ASLR on.

author: gettransilience
text: CVE-2026-111497 (CVSS 9.2) actively exploited, in CISA KEV. Out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder affects Node.js, Python, .NET, Bun, Envoy, Istio; DoS or RCE.

author: SBSentinellive
text: CRITICAL Adobe Commerce / Magento flaw (CVE-2026-48356) lets attackers upload code to online stores. CISA says actively exploited. Patch by Nov 10.

author: TheHackersNews
text: CISA adds two actively exploited flaws in Adobe Commerce/Magento (PolyShell, hundreds of stores breached) and Google Brotli (Node2Shell, RCE attempts in the wild) to KEV.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: PHP active exploitation confirmed: CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619 (RCE). Update to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-109618: PHP2Shell unauthenticated RCE actively exploited; CISA added to KEV.

author: shahzadFreelanc
text: Microsoft patched an actively exploited Windows zero-day CVE-2026-96951 (CVSS 8.8) in Windows Shell that bypasses Mark-of-the-Web.

author: engrbilalwaris
text: Apple backported its fix for actively exploited CoreGraphics flaw CVE-2026-86950 (CVSS 8.8) to iOS/iPadOS 18.7.11 for older devices.

author: PenTestBids
text: CVE-2026-110447: Critical Nextcloud command injection actively exploited, CVSS v4 9.2.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2026-112353 in GFI KerioConnect Webmail: stored XSS actively exploited, steals credentials and session tokens via malicious SVG attachment.

author: HespressEnglish
text: Morocco's DGSSI issued an urgent bulletin warning of severe vulnerabilities affecting a wide range of Apple devices.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: Microsoft named the actor behind the ConnectWise supply-chain attack: a China-aligned group running ARTEX, an open-source AI pen-testing framework; a fleet of agents went from first contact to privileged cloud access in under three hours.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI-assisted extortion operation n0n hit 93 victims, demanded $283.7M total, and ran its entire attack toolkit through an LLM coding agent; exposed staging server revealed the playbook.

author: nullptr_sh
text: VS Code + Copilot: agent could silently edit custom hook files (auto-approved writes); prompt injection leads to shell in a hook. Fixed in VS Code 1.141.1 (CVE-2026-102232).

author: GlazeScanHQ
text: CVE-2026-115413 (High): AWS API MCP Server accepted auth tokens issued to other apps in the same account. Fixed in 1.6.0.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Two MCP clients fixed sign-in flaws letting a malicious MCP server run commands: MCP Inspector (2.12.0 / 1.0.3) and OpenCode on Windows/WSL (1.18.33+). No CVEs.

author: nullptr_sh
text: opencode on Windows/WSL: a remote MCP server can RCE you during OAuth. No CVE; fixed in 1.18.33. Affected 1.0.137-1.18.32.

author: WuRichard_
text: NVIDIA scanned 31,132 AI agent skills: 26.1% vulnerable, 5.2% likely malicious.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Trojanized LiteLLM 1.107.0 pushed to PyPI and Docker on Oct 21 hooks Python startup to steal credentials; supply chain attack traced to a months-old unrotated key giving full CI/CD control.

author: PexlensX
text: LiteLLM v1.107.0 compromised: attackers hijacked the release pipeline and pointed it at lookalike repo Berri-AI/litellm.

author: Dekrov_Dev
text: JFrog: 42 real GitHub repositories weaponized with AI-tool autorun hooks for Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor and VS Code; opening a workspace could execute a hidden payload.

author: VarunChopr17597
text: testmetest npm worm planted hidden hooks in 42 GitHub repos; opening in Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor or VS Code runs .github/init.js.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Aokigahara infostealer adds collection routines targeting local AI coding assistants, turning developer workstations into cloud and pipeline pivot points.

author: immunisense
text: PingCAP TiDB Cloud breach started with one compromised GitHub account; attacker used keys and tokens in private repos and Terraform state to reach Google Cloud, Jira and internal chat.

author: mredu000
text: Railway got hit, ~100k workspaces had env vars potentially exposed. Now Bunny. PaaS/CDN platforms becoming honeypots for AI keys (unconfirmed report on Bunny).

author: Dinosn
text: Supply chain attack compromises Convertr e-commerce platform.

author: VeyloraSecurity
text: GMO Internet Group refused a $50M extortion demand after its Desktop Cloud breach; leaked trading logins used for unauthorized trades.

author: infrastack_ai
text: GhostAction supply chain campaign: 22,964 repos targeted, 72,000+ malicious commits, 1,792 accounts compromised, payloads going after CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials.

author: JtCrawford
text: 26,400 live credentials exposed on Gitee (China's largest Git platform): database strings, API keys, cloud tokens.

author: SendTechtimes
text: JFrog identified compromised repositories carrying developer-tool execution hooks, with stolen credentials linking npm releases to further repository attacks.
